_notes.environments: Pick a target with `--env=<name>` (the npm scripts do this) or PHARMASSIST_ENV=<name>. defaultEnv=local, so `npm start` uses the local backend. `npm run prod` points at the hosted testeps box, where the real example prescription (example.barcode) resolves. `npm run demo` uses the local backend with the scripted RX2024 pack→scenario mapping (needs the local backend in PHARMAPI_MOCK=true). Explicit PHARMASSIST_BACKEND_URL / PHARMASSIST_WEBAPP_URL still win over the selected environment.
_notes.example: A real ΗΔΥΚΑ/testeps prescription. Hotkey Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+0 fires it as a simulated scan — use it to test `--env=prod` (or any live backend) without the physical scanner. Resolves only when the target backend is in live mode (PHARMAPI_MOCK=false); the prod box already is.
_notes.scan.interKeyMs: A keystroke burst whose keys arrive within this gap is treated as a scanner (humans type slower). Terminated by Enter.
_notes.scan.sentinelPrefix: PRODUCTION posture: program the Eyoyo with a distinctive prefix and set it here so the hook reacts ONLY to sentinel-framed scans, never general typing. Empty = burst-timing detection (fine for research).
_notes.demo: Your Eyoyo packs are GS1 MEDICINE packs with no prescription attached. In the `demo` env, mapUnknownToDemo maps any scanned code that isn't an RX id to a demo prescription, deterministically (same pack → same scenario). Printed RX2024-xxx barcodes (npm run barcodes) resolve directly. prescriptions[0] is the headliner (Warfarin BLOCK); the list also backs the Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+1..8 hotkeys.
